# anthropic_federation_rule (Data Source)

Reads a Workload Identity Federation (WIF) rule by ID (`GET /v1/organizations/federation_rules/{id}`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique tagged identifier of the federation rule (`fdrl_...`).

### Read-Only

- `applies_to_all_workspaces` (Boolean) Whether the federation rule applies to all workspaces.
- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the rule was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the rule was created.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the federation rule.
- `issuer_id` (String) ID of the associated federation issuer (`fdis_...`).
- `match` (Attributes) Claim matching conditions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))
- `name` (String) Slug name of the federation rule.
- `oauth_scope` (String) Space-separated OAuth scope(s) granted on minted tokens.
- `service_account_id` (String) Target service account ID (`svac_...`).
- `token_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of minted OAuth tokens in seconds.
- `type` (String) Object type (`federation_rule`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the rule was last updated.
- `workspace_ids` (Set of String) Set of workspace IDs where this federation rule is enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Read-Only:

- `audience` (String) Exact match against the JWT `aud` claim, or `null`.
- `claims` (Map of String) Exact-match `{claim: value}` pairs, or `null`.
- `condition` (String) CEL expression over `claims`, or `null`.
- `subject_prefix` (String) Match against the JWT `sub` claim, or `null`.
